name: Folio Commons
stage: Planning; task contracts prepared, execution and product implementation not approved or completed

waves.title: A shared model for editable work
waves.outcome: Define the smallest document graph and change language.

waves.title: One connected document package
waves.outcome: Implement the first useful cross-artifact workflow.

waves.title: Human and agent edits stay reviewable
A workspace people can use daily

tasks.title: Specify the memo-sheet-slide model
tasks.goal: Model cells, paragraphs, charts, references and typed edit operations.
acceptanceCriteria: A single source value can be traced to its uses in a memo and a slide.
Operations distinguish proposed changes from accepted document state.
tasks.body:
Model cells, paragraphs, charts, references and typed edit operations.

Start only after the listed prerequisites and scope are accepted by a maintainer. Work in the project's own repository. Document assumptions, unresolved questions and reproducible evidence. This is a proposed work package, not a claim that the implementation already exists.

tasks.title: Create compatibility and conflict fixtures
tasks.goal: Build small examples of formulas, references, concurrent edits and broken links.
acceptanceCriteria: Each fixture declares expected round-trip behavior and unsupported features.
Conflicting human and agent edits have a visible resolution outcome.

Build small examples of formulas, references, concurrent edits and broken links.

tasks.goal: Implement the bounded cell model, formula subset and referenced text blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing a source cell updates its declared dependents without changing unrelated content.
Invalid formulas and missing references appear as errors rather than invented values.

acceptanceCriteria: The displayed chart can be traced to its source cells.

acceptanceCriteria: A user can accept one proposed edit and reject another independently.
